conflicts.resolution: Keep UME120 daily table,260 departure/two-shift update,269 DSN and270 CENEM as separate source claims; no averaging or substitute initial roster.
Report prose starts BRIF on11September while MITECO ground category appears10September. Category identity or date cannot be assumed.
Sept9 AP7 km157–174 index status, Sept13 eight-road status and incident-total10 closures have distinct clocks/scopes.
Red Cross reports level1 at03:37 on9September; other existing reports cite03:34. Primary activation order not recovered; do not silently choose or interpolate.
Cruz Roja's14September extinguished wording conflicts with official control14September/final extinction24October; official distinctions retained.
Figure22,13September lists24+20+4+1+1=50 aircraft but prints51 total. Preserve components and reported total separately; no missing aircraft invented.

real_gaps.needed: Unit-by-unit on-duty roster at8September21:35, station/base, capability, crew strength, assignment to other incidents, maintenance and dispatchability.
Per-unit dispatch, en-route, arrival, task start/end, shift relief, rest and release clocks. Initial assignment list does not supply them.
2021 mapping of ME/MP/BRICA and other codes to unit type, base, staffed vehicle and crew size; duplicate assignments resolved against originals.
Nonpersonal timestamped message metadata, acknowledgement/readback, command-to-sector handoffs and warning receipt/coverage. No transcripts sought or retained.
Incident radio/channel/repeater plan, coverage/outage metadata and resource-specific telemetry distribution times. UMMT/UNASIF presence alone does not supply these.
Authenticated2021 provincial staffing and facility allocation.2020/2022/current catalogues cannot validate2021 staffing; news reproductions excluded.
Unit staging/arrival coordinates and exact operational sectors. Named roads/settlements are not geocoded; no station coordinates invented.
Minute-level legal closure, emergency-access exceptions and reopening intervals, especially Sept8–9. Available dates and kilometer extents are status reports.
Order issue/receipt/implementation clocks by settlement, evacuation routes and people actually present. Aggregate totals are not compliance observations.
Primary Sept8–9 INFOCA/112 bulletin originals and exact publication times; one Sept9 DSN index update found but full body unavailable.
Report explicitly says plans are synthesized, not complete originals (PDFp14). Source publication2022 and later chronology cannot establish actor receipt in2021.
